mapper.select: SELECT schema_version AS schemaVersion, catalog_json::text AS catalogJson, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.wasm_catalog_sources WHERE game_id = #{gameId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.wasm_catalog_sources (game_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, schema_version, catalog_json, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{schemaVersion}, CAST(#{catalogJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, schema_version = EXCLUDED.schema_version, catalog_json = EXCLUDED.catalog_json, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.wasm_catalog_sources (game_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, schema_version, catalog_json, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{schemaVersion}, CAST(#{catalogJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.wasm_catalog_sources_log (game_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, schema_version, catalog_json) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{schemaVersion}, CAST(#{catalogJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, schema_version = EXCLUDED.schema_version, catalog_json = EXCLUDED.catalog_json
